The Illinois Municipal Retirement Fund (IMRF) has committed up to $70 million to Mesirow Financial Real Estate Value Fund VI, according to IMRF investment news.

This fund, a program of Mesirow Financial, is a closed-end, value-added fund investing primarily in existing value-added apartment assets, alongside a selective allocation of up to 25 percent of fund assets into new development projects.

IMRF is an existing investor in Mesirow Financial Real Estate Value Fund V, the fund’s predecessor, with $25 million in aggregate commitment. Mesirow Financial Real Estate Value Fund V closed with $1.245 billion in investor commitments in 2025.

IMRF, a public pension fund, had $65 billion in total assets under management as of June 30. According to Ask IRE.IQ, the market intelligence tool of Institutional Real Estate, Inc., in February 2024, IMRF approved a 10.5 percent target for private real assets effective Jan. 1, 2024.
